description: A genuine, minimal, one-page PDF with a text layer. The point of the fixture is the NAME it is uploaded under.

cases.why: Magic bytes say %PDF-; the extension and Content-Type say CSV. The bytes decide.
Same bytes under an honest name: a readable one-page statement PDF.

notes: The content stream is uncompressed so the text-layer probe can read it without inflating; the probe handles FlateDecode too.
The file carries no /JavaScript, /OpenAction, /Launch or /EmbeddedFile, so IMP-FILE-008 does not fire.
